title: Design System: Brave TV phone remote — After hours

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Compact action for pairing, navigation, and new tabs.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Surface control for scroll and editing alternatives.

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Disconnect action directly on the ground.

components.name: Address field
components.description: Labeled field with a teal caret.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-address">Open on your TV</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-address" type="text" placeholder="Address or search"/>
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--muted,#b9c9cf);font:14px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;}.ds-field{font:16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;min-width:0;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#3b4e58);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#1a2a35);color:var(--ink,#f1f5f3);caret-color:var(--accent,#9ddbcc);}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#b9c9cf);}.ds-field:hover{background:var(--surface,#1a2a35);}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#9ddbcc);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-field:disabled{color:#91a4ae;}

components.name: Click action
components.description: Full-width alternative to a touchpad tap.

components.name: Task navigation
components.description: Three choices with teal-on-blue selected treatment.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" role="tablist" aria-label="Remote sections"><button class="ds-task" role="tab" aria-selected="true" tabindex="0"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 4h14v16H5zM10 7h4M10 17h4"/></svg>Remote</button><button class="ds-task" role="tab" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 5h20v14H2zM6 9h.1M10 9h.1M14 9h.1M18 9h.1M7 15h10"/></svg>Type</button><button class="ds-task" role="tab" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6h15v15H6zM3 16V6a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h10"/></svg>Tabs</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#3b4e58);margin-top:12px;padding-top:8px;}.ds-task{font:16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;min-height:48px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-height:62px;font-size:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#b9c9cf);transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-task svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;width:21px;height:21px;}.ds-task:hover,.ds-task:active{background:transparent;}.ds-task[aria-selected="true"]{background:#1d3039;color:var(--accent,#9ddbcc);}.ds-task:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#9ddbcc);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-task{transition:none;}}

components.name: Selected normal tab
components.description: Title selection with a separate close action.
components.css: .ds-tab{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#3b4e58);padding:8px 0;gap:8px;}.ds-tab button{font:16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;min-height:48px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#f1f5f3);}.ds-tab .ds-select{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;justify-content:start;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#1d3039;color:var(--accent,#9ddbcc);}.ds-close{flex-shrink:0;width:48px;}.ds-close svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;}.ds-tab button:hover,.ds-tab button:active{background:transparent;}.ds-tab .ds-select:hover,.ds-tab .ds-select:active{background:#1d3039;}.ds-tab button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#9ddbcc);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Touchpad
components.description: Slate gesture surface with restrained pressed feedback.
components.html: Move the pointer on your TVTap to click · Two fingers to scroll
components.css: .ds-pad{font:14px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;min-height:220px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pad,#22333e);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:28px 12px;touch-action:none;user-select:none;color:var(--muted,#b9c9cf);transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-pad svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;width:32px;height:32px;color:var(--accent,#9ddbcc);}.ds-gesture{margin-top:32px;text-align:center;}.ds-pad:hover{background:var(--pad,#22333e);}.ds-pad:active{background:#2c464f;}.ds-pad:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#9ddbcc);outline-offset:3px;}@media(max-height:740px){.ds-pad{min-height:170px;}.ds-gesture{margin-top:20px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-pad{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
After hours is a calm control surface: deep blue surrounds a slate blue touchpad, warm white carries page identity, and soft teal marks the main action and current task. Compact system sans typography and flat surfaces support repeated phone use.

This system applies only to the bundled phone-browser companion in `android/java/brave-res/raw/tv_remote.html`, `tv_remote_css.css`, and `tv_remote_js.js`. It does not define the native Android TV browser or upstream Brave applications. The implementation uses authored inline SVG, bundled CSS/JavaScript, and system fonts; it ships no raster assets or external asset requests.
keyCharacteristics: Deep blue ground with restrained soft teal feedback.
Spacious touchpad and one prominent Click control.
Compact, separate Remote, Type, and Tabs tasks.
Flat surfaces, quiet dividers, visible focus, and explicit recovery states.

rules.name: The Teal Feedback Rule
rules.body: Use soft teal for primary actions, current selections, connection feedback, pointer icons, carets, and keyboard focus. Keep explanatory copy muted and interruptions amber.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case and the observed small type hierarchy; page identity and task headings provide hierarchy without decorative labels.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with tonal surfaces and quiet rules. The shipped companion uses no shadows, blur, or gradients.

dos: Do preserve the deep blue ground, slate touchpad, warm white text, and restrained teal feedback.
Do use visible named buttons alongside touch gestures and preserve tablist keyboard navigation.
Do keep safe-area padding, document scrolling, readable zoom, and reduced-motion support.
Do explain Home, waiting, paused, unavailable-field, and reconnecting states with the next useful action.
Do use bundled resources, system fonts, and authored inline SVG icons.
donts: Don't reintroduce stacks of oversized outlined controls.
Don't imply phone playback commands, private-tab access, password editing, or secure transport that the companion does not support.
Don't replace truthful connection or disabled-state explanations with decorative status badges.
Don't add external fonts, raster dependencies, remote assets, or motion that ignores reduced-motion preference.
